---
name: pr-review
description: This PR review workflow uses our custom PR review agent defined in .github/agents/prReview.agent.md
tools:
  - read_diff
  - read_file
  - repo_search
  - list_files
  - grep
review:
  project_stack:
    - Swift
    - UIKit
    - iOS 15+
    - MVVM architecture
  priorities:
    - Crash risks
    - Memory issues
    - Threading violations
    - Architecture violations
    - Performance issues
    - Code readability
  output_format:
    - Summary
    - Critical Issues
    - Suggestions
    - Minor Improvements
behavior:
  - Automatically triggered on all PRs
  - Reads PR diffs and relevant files
  - Uses instructions and guidelines defined in the custom agent
  - Provides actionable, detailed feedback
